The '''Light Bending BARC Speeder''' was a variant of the [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] that was utilized by various individuals during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
It was a one-person, modified repulsorlift speederbike once used by specialized [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]] to go on highly dangerous missions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This particular speeder bent the light around it to add a shimmering, ghostly effect.

==Behind the scenes==
This vehicle is given out to players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' who redeem 'Buddy Tokens.' These tokens are awarded for inviting people to play ''Star Wars Galaxies''.
